caption: The image shows a round ceramic plate featuring a central illustration of a large, three-story rectangular building with regularly spaced windows and two chimneys on the roof. The building has a staircase leading up to a portico with columns at the entrance. There are two fenced areas in front, one with a smaller structure or shed on the left side, and some trees or foliage on the right side. In the foreground, a person is standing near the fence in front of the building. The sky above the building is filled with clouds. The scene is enclosed within a circular border, and the plate’s wide rim is decorated with a repeating floral pattern of large flowers and leaves. The drawing uses shades of gray and black, consistent with monochrome or black-and-white photography, with no visible color aside from this grayscale palette.
title: Plate - "Athaneum, Boston"
